task: In ai-services/mcp-server/tools/attractions.py, the attractions.search MCP tool filters a student-3 attraction list by category and min_rating, then returns {attractions: attractions[:params.limit]}. Add a total_matches field to the returned dict, equal to len(attractions) counted AFTER the category and min_rating filters are applied but BEFORE the params.limit slice. Do not change the existing category/limit validation, the min_rating filtering behaviour, or the fact that attractions stays sliced to params.limit. Follow the TODO(you) comment already present just above the return statement in the search() function. Example 1: fetching 12 attractions with category=activity and no min_rating, params.limit=5 -> return {attractions: <first 5 of the 12>, total_matches: 12}. Example 2: same 12 attractions but min_rating=4.6 narrows matches to 3, params.limit=5 -> return {attractions: <all 3>, total_matches: 3} (total_matches must reflect the min_rating-filtered count, not the original 12, since min_rating is a real filter and limit is only a page size).
